name: Sales as built
description:
This design reads the Sales code as it was built before the threshold-activated discount, every element added to an empty model: [Sales](noesis:module|Sales) prices a client's products for a sales channel and takes an [Order](noesis:building_block|Sales.Orders.Order) through price confirmation to placement. It is the starting point the "Threshold-activated discount" change builds on.

# Where it lands

- [Pricing](noesis:module|Sales.Pricing) works out what products cost a client, with [PriceLists](noesis:module|Sales.Pricing.PriceLists), [Discounts](noesis:module|Sales.Pricing.Discounts) and [SpecialOffers](noesis:module|Sales.Pricing.SpecialOffers) inside it.
- [Orders](noesis:module|Sales.Orders) holds the order and its price agreements; [PriceChanges](noesis:module|Sales.Orders.PriceChanges) inside it decides when agreed prices may change.
- [Clients](noesis:module|Sales.Clients), [Products](noesis:module|Sales.Products), [Commons](noesis:module|Sales.Commons), [ExchangeRates](noesis:module|Sales.ExchangeRates), [SalesChannels](noesis:module|Sales.SalesChannels) and [Time](noesis:module|Sales.Time) hold the values both rely on. [Integrations](noesis:module|Sales.Integrations) and its [RiskManagement](noesis:module|Sales.Integrations.RiskManagement) module hold no building block.

# Where to start reading

1. [CalculatePrices.For](noesis:behavior|Sales.Pricing.CalculatePrices.For) prices product amounts for a client, sales channel and currency, giving a [Quote](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.Quote) or an [Offer](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.Offer).
2. [OfferModifiers.ChooseFor](noesis:behavior|Sales.Pricing.OfferModifiers.ChooseFor) picks how an [OfferRequest](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.OfferRequest) is modified: the special offers, over [IndividualSalesConditions](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.IndividualSalesConditions) in wholesale or [ProductLevelDiscounts](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.Discounts.ProductLevelDiscounts) elsewhere. Each is an [OfferModifier](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.OfferModifier).
3. [Order](noesis:building_block|Sales.Orders.Order), the one aggregate: it [adds](noesis:behavior|Sales.Orders.Order.Add) product amounts, [confirms prices](noesis:behavior|Sales.Orders.Order.ConfirmPrices) from an offer and is [placed](noesis:behavior|Sales.Orders.Order.Place).
4. [PriceChangesPolicies.ChooseFor](noesis:behavior|Sales.Orders.PriceChanges.PriceChangesPolicies.ChooseFor) gives the [PriceChangesPolicy](noesis:building_block|Sales.Orders.PriceChanges.PriceChangesPolicy) an order's price confirmation follows, by the client's [ClientStatus](noesis:building_block|Sales.Clients.ClientStatus).

# Around them

- Discounts: [Discount](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.Discounts.Discount) is a [PercentageDiscount](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.Discounts.PercentageDiscount) or a [ValueDiscount](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.Discounts.ValueDiscount); [ClientLevelDiscounts](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.Discounts.ClientLevelDiscounts) and [ProductDiscount](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.Discounts.ProductDiscount) say who gets which.
- Special offers: [SpecialOffer](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.SpecialOffers.SpecialOffer), with [ThreeForTwo](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.SpecialOffers.ThreeForTwo) and [EverySecondBoxForHalfPrice](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.SpecialOffers.EverySecondBoxForHalfPrice) falling back on another modifier.
- Orders: the [Factory](noesis:building_block|Sales.Orders.Factory) and [Repository](noesis:building_block|Sales.Orders.Repository) of orders, and [PriceAgreement](noesis:building_block|Sales.Orders.PriceAgreement) for each item's price.
- Repositories: [ClientRepository](noesis:building_block|Sales.Clients.ClientRepository), [DiscountsRepository](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.Discounts.DiscountsRepository) and [PriceListRepository](noesis:building_block|Sales.Pricing.PriceLists.PriceListRepository).
- Values: [Money](noesis:building_block|Sales.Commons.Money), [Percentage](noesis:building_block|Sales.Commons.Percentage), [ProductAmount](noesis:building_block|Sales.Products.ProductAmount), [ProductUnit](noesis:building_block|Sales.Products.ProductUnit) and the rest of Commons and Products.

# Not in this design

- No properties, inputs, results, relations, rules or scenarios: the C# scanner reads none of them, and the design carries only what the scan returns.
- Types without a `Ddd*` attribute, among them `OrderId`, `Order.Item`, the order's events, `ExchangeRateProvider` and `RiskManagementIntegration`; the `TechnicalStuff` namespaces and the test project.
